title: Matrix Cauchy evolution and the causal boundary split
reviewed_arguments: C0 checks every scalar Cauchy hypothesis for the principal wave operator, including the two uniformly separated roots and the exact D_t initial convention.
C1 proves two-time restart, inverse and joint strong continuity; smooth approximation gives the actual Bochner forcing formula and its integrated generator on the correct Sobolev scales.

C2 retains arbitrary complex matrix lower terms as a bounded perturbation on H^{s+1} plus H^s for every real s. Ordered nested integration gives the factorial bound, whole-interval convergence and uniqueness without commuting matrices.

C3 proves the full matrix Cauchy theorem, L1 forcing bound, both time directions, compatibility of orders and smoothness for smooth Sobolev data. Scalar forced uniqueness identifies the Volterra solution.

C4 verifies the positive Schur complement and extends normalized coefficients through positive convex combinations while preserving all q blocks. Every localization commutator term remains in the source.

C5 derives actual H and V* time traces from the weak equation, chooses a common almost-everywhere energy slice, and proves the correct zero or even extension. It does not presume strong energy continuity at every slice.
C6 proves the H1 zero extension of the matched difference and derives the exact delta and delta-prime coefficients, including the derivative of a. Both jets vanish in their actual weak trace spaces.

C7 takes the actual graph boundary trace of the causal difference instead of multiplying an arbitrary rough trace by a step function. Its complete borderline Fourier proof excludes a time-corner distribution in H^{-1/2}. Full Robin gauge and test/data factors are retained.

C8 proves only the stated complete-data comparison over the closed dependence region using ADT, AWT and TBU. It explicitly retains the remaining microlocal source reduction, complementary boundary response and natural-dual source gaps.

All three exercises have complete solutions. Twenty exact checks test the matrix order, principal roots, Schur complement, time-interface sign, gauge, extension norms and causal profiles. The original figure uses exact functions and labels the delta as a distribution.

Thirteen entries bind to 1054 earlier entries in 57 exact current maps, with 102 external Lebl proofs. The full general Airy representation, sharp Airy mapping, strict propagation and whole course remain unfinished.
